points.description: States FALSE (processes of the same program do not share one PCB).
Justification: each process is an independent entity needing its own PCB/OS state (e.g., separate registers, memory, stack, open files), which a shared PCB cannot provide.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if the justification is vague, e.g., says each process needs its own PCB without saying why.

rubric.notes: Full marks: FALSE with a reason that each process needs its own separate PCB or state, in any wording. Give part marks for FALSE with a vague reason. Per the question, a correct justification is needed to earn marks, so TRUE or no justification earns 0.
